verdict.rationale: Docusign CLM docs reference AI-driven agreement analysis, auto-populated data from systems like Salesforce, and API/MCP tools that 'retrieve agreement context and metadata,' implying some repository/metadata capability, but no evidence explicitly describes a searchable executed-contract repository with structured key-term extraction and search UI. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a searchable contract repository, details on what metadata/terms are extracted and how search works, and independent/hands-on validation of this specific capability.
